title: High-efficiency polymer solar cells with small photon energy loss
subject: Physics
question: What is the approximate open-circuit voltage (eVoc) for the PNOz4T/PC71BM cell (red data) at a temperature of 250 K?

gold_answer.long_answer: To find the eVoc for the PNOz4T/PC71BM cell at 250 K, locate 250 K on the x-axis. Move vertically up to the red data points/line. Then, move horizontally to the left to read the corresponding value on the y-axis (eVoc). The value is approximately 1.0 eV.

original_caption:
The plot displays the temperature dependence of the open-circuit voltage (eVoc, in eV) for two organic photovoltaic cells: PNOz4T/PC71BM (red data points and line) and PNTz4T/PC71BM (blue data points and line). The x-axis represents temperature in Kelvin (K), ranging from 0 to 300 K. The y-axis represents eVoc, ranging from 0.6 to 1.6 eV.

For the PNOz4T/PC71BM cell (red), eVoc decreases linearly with increasing temperature, starting from approximately 1.38 eV at 0 K and decreasing to about 0.95
